notes.title: Winner of the 10-Level Challenge!
notes.content:
A huge congratulations to the winner of the challenge!The name of the winner is:RevVoice

We also want to give a big thank you to everyone who took partin this event. Your support makes  these challenges so much fun!

What's next:This was just the beginning! We're already preparing the nextchallenge. This time, it's going to be a new and separate puzzle, accessiblefrom the main menu of the game!

STAY TUNED!!!

notes.title: Level 10 Challenge!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We're excited to launch the ... Level 10 Challenge!  - A fun way to dive deeper into Brainkilled and win cool prizes!


How to enter:

Reach & Beat Level 10 in Brainkilled before Sept 1st!

Send a screenshot of level 11 to "brainkilledchallenge_10@hotmail.com" as well as 

your Steam Profile URL!

Dont own the game yet? No problem! You can enter for free by sending "Count me in" to the same email including your Steam Profile URL!


The WINNER gets a €50 Steam gift card!

But hurry - challenge ends Sept 1! Are you ready to level up and win?
